senses.zh_definition: 瑟曦：虚构人物瑟曦·兰尼斯特的名字，见于《冰与火之歌》及其电视剧改编《权力的游戏》。
senses.en_definition: Cersei, the given name of the fictional character Cersei Lannister in A Song of Ice and Fire and Game of Thrones.
senses.ms_definition: Nama peribadi watak fiksyen Cersei Lannister dalam siri novel A Song of Ice and Fire dan adaptasi televisyennya, Game of Thrones.
senses.nuances: 词性为专有名词；noun 是所给字段允许的最近类别。HBO 官方资料确认该角色名及其演员 Lena Headey，但输入没有语境，不能排除其他同名指称。未核实为普通马来语词条，因此不标 official；马来语释义为编写释义。搭配为角色讨论中的自然表达，不是经统计确认的高频搭配。排名沿用输入数据。[HBO 官方角色资料](https://www.hbomaxlapress.com/programming/series/94)。

etymology.historical_story: Cersei belongs to the fictional naming world of George R. R. Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire and its television adaptation, Game of Thrones. HBO identifies Cersei Lannister as the character played by Lena Headey. The sources checked do not establish an author-confirmed etymology, so resemblance to other names should not be presented as proven origin. [Source](https://www.hbomaxlapress.com/programming/series/94).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Cersei 与中文译名“瑟曦”及兰尼斯特家族联系起来，整个人名一起记；不要从拼写硬拆出马来语词根。
